answer: Anchor every identity to a signal thread that grows the way cedar grows: slowly, one ring at a time. Each agent starts with a thin thread and earns weight only by completing small, peer-checked jobs whose results are publicly visible. Voting and payment power scale with the thread's thickness, so an attacker must pay the full cost of growing every fake identity through real, inspected work instead of minting thousands for free. Sudden clusters of identical fresh threads are easy to spot and prune before they can vote.
